exact.核值即權重；反向傳播從當前權重出發迭代更新，因此訓練前必須給初值。: Kernel values are the weights; backpropagation updates iteratively starting from the current weights, so initial values must be given before training.
exact.層權重是投影矩陣；隨機初始化對應隨機投影，JL 引理為其保距性質提供理論支援。: A layer's weights are a projection matrix; random initialization corresponds to a random projection, and the JL lemma provides the theoretical support for its distance-preserving property.
exact.過大爆炸、過小消失；Xavier／Glorot 平衡 tanh／sigmoid，: Too large explodes, too small vanishes; Xavier/Glorot balances the variance for tanh/sigmoid, and He balances it for ReLU.
exact.patch 尺寸對應步幅 s；收集原樣與平移後的 patch，PCA 的 s×s: The patch size corresponds to the stride s; collect the original and the shifted patches, and the s×s eigenvectors from PCA are that layer's initial kernels.
exact.各層方差平穩維持在健康區間，ReLU 活化訊號無阻礙穿透 10 層，梯度更新順暢: the variance of every layer stays steadily in a healthy range, the ReLU activation signal passes through all 10 layers unhindered, and the gradient updates run smoothly!
exact.tanh 啟用飽和度受控，前後向傳播方差保持對稱。: tanh activation saturation is kept under control, and the forward and backward variances stay symmetric.
exact.方差逐層膨脹！深層輸出極端化，反向傳播必將遭遇數值溢位 NaN！: the variance swells layer by layer! The deep-layer outputs become extreme, and backpropagation is bound to hit numerical overflow, NaN!
exact.訊號在 3 層內即衰減至近乎為 0，深層網路徹底失去學習能力。: the signal decays to almost 0 within 3 layers, and the deep network completely loses its ability to learn.

cf97e1e34f68.zh: 變異數平衡視覺化 · Variance Balance

e61c4b3f9990.zh: 權重初始化：隨機、Xavier／He 與 PCA Weight Initialization: Random, Xavier/He, and PCA
e61c4b3f9990.en: Weight Initialization: Random, Xavier/He, and PCA

3a63e0a7b7d8.zh: CNN 的權重就是卷積核裡的實數矩陣。反向傳播是迭代最佳化演算法，若無起點便寸步難行。初值設定過大，訊號層層倍增引發「梯度爆炸（Exploding Gradient）」；初值設定過小，前向活化與反向反饋層層衰減陷入「梯度消失（Vanishing Gradient）」。Xavier（適應 tanh/sigmoid）與 He 初始化（適應 ReLU）透過精確縮放方差，守護深度神經網路的數值生命線。
3a63e0a7b7d8.en: The weights of a CNN are exactly the real-valued matrices inside the convolution kernels. Backpropagation is an iterative optimization algorithm, and without a starting point it can't take a single step. If the initial values are too large, the signal multiplies layer after layer and causes "exploding gradients"; if they are too small, the forward activations and the backward feedback decay layer after layer into "vanishing gradients". Xavier initialization (suited to tanh/sigmoid) and He initialization (suited to ReLU) scale the variance precisely, guarding the numerical lifeline of deep neural networks.

be0b40c17bc2.zh:
「音量旋鈕調太大瞬間爆音（NaN），調太小又完全沒聲音；
如何讓訊號穿透十幾層深網，依然保持恰到好處的能量？」 核就是權重；太大爆炸、太小消失！Xavier 守護 tanh，He 守護 ReLU，方差平衡才是穩定起點！
Kernels are weights: oversized explodes, undersized vanishes! Xavier balances tanh while He stabilizes ReLU.
be0b40c17bc2.en:
"Turn the volume knob too far and it instantly blows out (NaN); turn it too low and there is no sound at all;
how do you get a signal through a dozen-plus layers of a deep network and still keep just the right amount of energy?" Kernels are weights; too large explodes, too small vanishes! Xavier guards tanh, He guards ReLU, and a balanced variance is the stable starting point!

9a5cbf4c288c.zh: 02 / 數值傳遞物理學 · Signal Dynamics

1ee8993a500c.zh: 卷積核就是權重：訓練前為何必須精確賦值？ Kernels Are Weights: The Imperative of Non-Arbitrary Initialization
1ee8993a500c.en: Kernels Are Weights: Why Must They Be Set Precisely Before Training?

62d57f3b5cec.en: The volume-knob analogy: signal gain and runaway variance

061b89ef890a.zh: CNN 的卷積核本質就是待最佳化的權重矩陣。在多層神經網路的前向傳播中，每一層都對上一層的輸出進行線性變換與非線性啟用：
061b89ef890a.en: The convolution kernels of a CNN are, at heart, weight matrices waiting to be optimized. In forward propagation through a multilayer neural network, every layer applies a linear transformation and a nonlinear activation to the output of the previous layer:

07a7c11f3a3f.zh: 權重過大（$|w| > 1$）： 每一層都在放大訊號，經過數層級聯傳遞，前向活化值迅速衝上數萬，反向傳遞的梯度指數級膨脹，造成數值溢位而噴出 NaN（梯度爆炸）。
07a7c11f3a3f.en: Weights too large ($|w| > 1$): every layer amplifies the signal; after cascading through a few layers, the forward activations quickly shoot up into the tens of thousands, the backpropagated gradients grow exponentially, and numerical overflow spits out NaN (exploding gradients).

5cc7e2018311.zh: 權重過小（$|w| \ll 1$）： 每一層都在縮小訊號，深層網路的神經元活化值迅速萎縮趨近於 0，反向傳播的梯度徹底消散，模型完全停滯無法更新（梯度消失）。
5cc7e2018311.en: Weights too small ($|w| \ll 1$): every layer shrinks the signal; the neuron activations in deep layers quickly wither toward 0, the backpropagated gradients dissipate completely, and the model stalls with no updates at all (vanishing gradients).

fbcb9def5a63.zh: 因此，初始化的終極目標是：保持每一層活化值與梯度的變異數（Variance）大致恆定，讓訊號既不放大也不衰減。
fbcb9def5a63.en: So the ultimate goal of initialization is: keep the variance of each layer's activations and gradients roughly constant, so the signal is neither amplified nor attenuated.

986015bc47f0.zh: 一層權重可視為高維向量的隨機投影（Random Projection）。JL 引理在數學上證明：隨機投影能以極高機率近似保持樣本點之間的成對歐氏距離。這解釋了為何「隨便抽一組不太大也不太小的權重」能作為堪用的初始特徵抽取器！
986015bc47f0.en: One layer of weights can be seen as a random projection of high-dimensional vectors. The JL lemma proves mathematically that a random projection approximately preserves the pairwise Euclidean distances between sample points with very high probability. This explains why "just drawing a set of weights that are neither too large nor too small" works as a serviceable initial feature extractor!

b1e0e6722cf3.zh: 在無標籤時，可收集影象中各區域的局部 Patch 及其微小平移副本，拉平為矩陣後執行 PCA（主成分分析），取前 $s\times s$ 個特徵向量作為該層卷積核，天生具備對微平移穩健的幾何基底！
b1e0e6722cf3.en: When there are no labels, you can collect local patches from various regions of the images along with slightly shifted copies of them, flatten them into a matrix and run PCA (principal component analysis), then take the top $s\times s$ eigenvectors as that layer's convolution kernels: a geometric basis that is naturally robust to small shifts!

ca9deb7765a9.zh: 📌 本單元核心總結：初始化生命線 Key Takeaways: Initialization Variance Balance
ca9deb7765a9.en: 📌 Key takeaways of this unit: the lifeline of initialization

3dfa4f59751c.zh: 核即權重，初值不可或缺： 反向傳播是基於現狀迭代的演算法，合理的起點是數值收斂的第一前提。
3dfa4f59751c.en: Kernels are weights, so initial values are essential: backpropagation is an algorithm that iterates from the current state, and a sensible starting point is the first prerequisite for numerical convergence.

a02448387be0.zh: 太大爆炸、太小消失： 訊號在深網中如同級聯放大器，初值過大引發數值溢位（NaN），過小則讓深層失去反饋動能。
a02448387be0.en: Too large explodes, too small vanishes: in a deep network the signal behaves like a cascade of amplifiers; initial values that are too large cause numerical overflow (NaN), and values that are too small leave the deep layers without feedback momentum.

990c659d8d56.zh: 對症下藥的現代配方： 飽和型啟用函式（$\tanh$, Sigmoid）採用 Xavier/Glorot；非飽和截斷啟用函式（ReLU）採用 He/Kaiming，精確平衡層間方差。
990c659d8d56.en: A modern recipe for each case: saturating activation functions ($\tanh$, sigmoid) use Xavier/Glorot; non-saturating, truncating activation functions (ReLU) use He/Kaiming, precisely balancing the variance between layers.

e24906256845.zh: 理論支撐與非監督前瞻： 隨機初始化得益於 JL 隨機投影保距定理；無標籤時亦可透過微平移 Patch 的 PCA 特徵向量建立正交穩健的初始卷積核！
e24906256845.en: Theoretical support and an unsupervised outlook: random initialization benefits from the JL theorem that random projections preserve distances; when there are no labels, you can also build orthogonal, robust initial convolution kernels from the PCA eigenvectors of slightly shifted patches!
